summary.text: Hillary Pugh Kent is a Republican member of the Virginia House of Delegates representing District 67, which covers King George County, Lancaster County, Northumberland County, Richmond County, Westmoreland County and part of Caroline County.
Hillary Pugh Kent has been a member since January 10, 2024.

paragraphs.text: According to the House profile, Hillary Pugh Kent was born in Richmond, Virginia.
Hillary Pugh Kent studied at Randolph-Macon College (B.A., 2003) and Virginia Commonwealth University (MPA, 2005).
Hillary Pugh Kent's listed occupation is sales and marketing management.
The profile lists Ryan C. Kent as Hillary Pugh Kent's spouse.
The House profile lists Hillary Pugh Kent's committee assignments as Education and Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources.
